dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: Ungggh... Wait... Where am I... Ugh...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: I... I encountered something terrifying... I... I found a flat gold nugget with runes drawn on it...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: Then someone... grabbed me by the shoulder... took me to... this person. He took the gold, and handed me some strange drink...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: I drank... again... and again... and now I've forgotten... so much. Don't even remember... my way home...

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: Oh, no, no. What help? Don't need it. I can... I'm fine. Just need... another drink...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: ...You're going to a pub to get some alcohol, aren't you?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You had a bit too much to drink again, didn't you?

dialogues.speaker: Vanya
dialogues.text: Ohh... Yeah. But I'm fine... see? Not... lying on the ground, see? I can still walk, y'know...
